What changed, and why.

Reads on a phone

The current site was built before mobile browsing was a serious concern. Roughly two-thirds of your future visitors will arrive on a phone — the new design is built mobile-first, and everything (menu, content, contact form) works cleanly at that size.

Says what you do, immediately

The first three seconds tell the visitor what the shop does, who it's for, and why to trust it — before any scroll. That's the whole difference between a curious visitor and a paying customer.

Your actual work, front and center

The signature sections are tailored to your trade — the timeline, the anatomy, the catalog. Not template stuff. A visitor should leave the site feeling like they met the shop, not a template.

Easy for you to update

When we hand over the finished site, you get a set of plain-English notes on how to change prices, add photos, or update your hours — no developer needed, no monthly headache.
